_help: The party windows (UIParty.img/mainUI): the party window with the member list and the search window with the players of the map. The numbers are the official spots: the WZ nodes carry the position as the image origin, so the spot is the origin without the minus. x/y = the top-left of the window in 1366x768 game pixels. The party window is 528x578 (the art size), the search window 504x504. wndX/wndY = the spot of the party panel inside the party window (the WZ vector:subWnd_lt). partyNameX/partyNameY = the party name (the WZ vector:partyName). noneDx/noneDy = the not-in-a-party layer on the party panel (the WZ origin). listX/listY = the top-left of the member list (the WZ vector:partyList_lt), counted from the party panel; searchListX/searchListY = the top-left of the search list, counted from the search window. rowPitch = the distance between two rows (the row art is 39 tall and the WZ entityMargin is 3, so the pitch is 42). searchTabX/searchTabY = the 'Search Party Members' tab of the search window (the WZ tab:partySearch). nameX/nameY and levelX/levelY = the text spots in a row (the WZ vector:pos). leaderX/leaderY = the leader mark spot, stateX/stateY = the online mark spot. numX/numY = the member counter (the WZ vector:partyNum0). btnMakeX/btnMakeY = the create party button, btnOutX/btnOutY = the leave button, btnInviteX/btnInviteY = the invite button (the WZ origins). closeX/closeY = the X of the party window, searchCloseX/searchCloseY = the X of the search window. titleH = the height of the strip that drags the window. The invite popup is the official dialogue box (UI/UIWindow2.img/UtilDlgEx): askX/askY = its top-left, askNameDx/askNameDy = the name on the tab, askTextDx/askTextDy/askTextW = the words under it, askLineStep = the distance between two lines, askBtnGap = the gap between the two buttons, askBtnY = the distance of the buttons to the bottom of the box.
